name: SLAMFuse
description: We propose SLAMFuse, an open-source SLAM benchmarking framework that provides consistent crossplatform environments for evaluating multi-modal SLAM algorithms, along with tools for data fuzzing, failure detection, and diagnosis across different datasets. Our framework introduces a fuzzing mechanism to test the resilience of SLAM algorithms against dataset perturbations. This enables the assessment of pose estimation accuracy under varying conditions and identifies critical perturbation thresholds.
